mapper.select:
SELECT X.HO_NO, X.DONG_NO, X.DONG_NM, X.HO, X.DISPLAY_DONG_HO,
X.METER_HSTRY_NO, X.FACILITY_NO, X.UTILITY_PROVIDER_NO, X.METER_DT, X.PRE_VAL, X.CURR_VAL, X.USAGE_VAL, X.METER_CN, X.METER_RSLT_CD,
X.BILL_ITEM_CD, X.BILL_ITEM_NM FROM ( SELECT H.HO_NO, U.DONG_NO, U.DONG_NM, H.HO, U.DONG_NM || ' ' || H.HO || '호' AS DISPLAY_DONG_HO,
M.METER_HSTRY_NO, M.FACILITY_NO, M.UTILITY_PROVIDER_NO, M.METER_DT, M.PRE_VAL, M.CURR_VAL, NVL(M.CURR_VAL, 0) - NVL(M.PRE_VAL, 0) AS USAGE_VAL, M.METER_CN, M.METER_RSLT_CD,
F.FACILITY_TY_CD AS BILL_ITEM_CD, C.CODE_NAME AS BILL_ITEM_NM,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.HO_NO, F.FACILITY_TY_CD ORDER BY M.METER_DT DESC, M.METER_HSTRY_NO DESC ) AS RN
FROM METER_HSTRY M JOIN FACILITY F ON M.FACILITY_NO = F.FACILITY_NO JOIN APT_DETAIL H ON M.HO_NO = H.HO_NO JOIN APT_UNIT U ON H.DONG_NO = U.DONG_NO JOIN UTILITY_PROVIDER UP ON M.UTILITY_PROVIDER_NO = UP.UTILITY_PROVIDER_NO AND UP.APT_CMPLEX_NO = U.APT_CMPLEX_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON C.GROUP_CODE_NO = 'EXPN_CD' AND C.CODE_NO_CD = F.FACILITY_TY_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
WHERE U.APT_CMPLEX_NO = #{aptCmplexNo} AND TO_CHAR(M.METER_DT, 'YYYYMM') = #{billYm} AND F.FACILITY_TY_CD IN ('ELC', 'WTR', 'GAS') AND M.METER_RSLT_CD IS NOT NULL ) X WHERE X.RN = 1 ORDER BY X.DONG_NM, X.HO, X.BILL_ITEM_CD
